ex.en: You'd better wear a sweater under your jacket.
ex.zh: 你最好在外套裡面加件毛衣。

ex.en: What do you think of this sweater?
ex.zh: 你覺得這件毛衣怎麼樣？

ex.en: That red sweater looks good on you.
ex.zh: 你穿那件紅毛衣很好看。

sweater.en: a warm piece of knitted clothing for the upper body

ex.en: I swapped a camera for a guitar.
ex.zh: 我用一台相機換了一把吉他。

ex.en: Can we swap seats?
ex.zh: 我們可以換個座位嗎？

ex.en: Let's swap shifts this weekend.
ex.zh: 這個週末我們換班吧。

swap.en: to give something to someone and get something else from them in return

ex.en: We arranged a shift swap with our coworkers.
ex.zh: 我們和同事安排了換班。

ex.en: The clothing swap event was a big success.
ex.zh: 換衣活動非常成功。

swap.en: an act of giving one thing and getting another thing in return

ex.en: A swallow flies very swiftly.
ex.zh: 燕子飛得非常快。

ex.en: With a glance of her, he left swiftly.
ex.zh: 他看了她一眼，就迅速離開了。

ex.en: The company acted swiftly to fix the problem.
ex.zh: 公司迅速採取行動解決問題。

ex.en: My hands and legs are swollen.
ex.zh: 我的手腳都腫了。

ex.en: How long have your cheeks been swollen?
ex.zh: 你的臉頰腫多久了？

swell.en: to become larger or rounder than normal, especially because of injury or illness

ex.en: Our surplus has swelled by nearly ten percent in this quarter.
ex.zh: 本季我們的盈餘增加了將近一成。

ex.en: The crowd swelled to over 10,000 people.
ex.zh: 人潮增加到一萬多人。

swell.en: to become bigger in size, number or amount

ex.en: I swam very well when I was a child.
ex.zh: 我小時候很會游泳。

ex.en: My younger brother swims every day in the summer.
ex.zh: 我弟弟夏天每天都去游泳。

ex.en: Who is the boy that is swimming over there?
ex.zh: 在那裡游泳的男孩是誰？

swim.en: to move through water by using your arms and legs

ex.en: Let's go for a swim after work.
ex.zh: 下班後我們去游個泳吧。

ex.en: I had a swim in the hotel pool.
ex.zh: 我在飯店的泳池游了泳。

swim.en: a period of time spent moving through water for fun or exercise

ex.en: Tom and Mary switched places on the bench.
ex.zh: 湯姆和瑪麗在長椅上換了位子。

ex.en: Many customers have switched to online banking.
ex.zh: 許多客戶已經改用網路銀行。

switch.en: to change from one thing to another, or to exchange one thing for another

switch.zh: switch on / off：打開／關掉（電器）

ex.en: Switch off the light. I can't get to sleep.
ex.zh: 把燈關掉，我睡不著。

ex.en: I was hot, so I switched on the fan.
ex.zh: 我很熱，所以打開了電風扇。

ex.en: I forgot to save the file before switching off.
ex.zh: 我關機前忘了存檔。

switch.en: to start or stop a machine or light by pressing a button or moving a control

ex.en: She groped for the light switch in the dark.
ex.zh: 她在黑暗中摸索電燈開關。

ex.en: The light switch is next to the door.
ex.zh: 電燈開關在門旁邊。

switch.en: a small control that you press or move to turn a machine or light on or off

ex.en: The switch to the new system went smoothly.
ex.zh: 換成新系統的過程很順利。

ex.en: She made the switch from sales to marketing.
ex.zh: 她從業務轉調到行銷部門。

switch.en: a change from one thing to another

ex.en: Those grapes look sweet, but in fact they're sour.
ex.zh: 那些葡萄看起來很甜，其實是酸的。

ex.en: I don't like drinking beverages that are too sweet.
ex.zh: 我不喜歡喝太甜的飲料。

ex.en: When it comes to sweets, I just can't control myself.
ex.zh: 一看到甜食，我就控制不了自己。

ex.en: According to dentists, tooth decay is not always caused by sweets.
ex.zh: 根據牙醫的說法，蛀牙不一定是甜食造成的。

sweet.en: small pieces of sugary food that you eat for pleasure

ex.en: It's so sweet of you to remember my birthday.
ex.zh: 你記得我的生日，真貼心。

ex.en: What a sweet little dog!
ex.zh: 好可愛的小狗！

sweet.en: kind and thoughtful, or pleasant and lovely

ex.en: Chris swung his sword!
ex.zh: 克里斯揮了一下劍。

ex.en: He swung the bat and hit the ball.
ex.zh: 他揮棒擊中了球。

swing.en: to move back and forth or in a curve while hanging or held from one point

ex.en: The kids are playing on the swings.
ex.zh: 孩子們在盪鞦韆。

ex.en: There is a swing in our backyard.
ex.zh: 我們後院有一座鞦韆。

swing.en: a seat hanging from ropes that a person sits on and moves back and forth

ex.en: Mennad always has those mood swings.
ex.zh: 梅納德的情緒總是起伏很大。

ex.en: There was a big swing in oil prices this year.
ex.zh: 今年油價波動很大。

swing.en: a sudden change from one state or level to another

ex.en: My father is sweeping the garage.
ex.zh: 我爸正在掃車庫。

ex.en: Don't forget to sweep the kitchen clean.
ex.zh: 別忘了把廚房掃乾淨。

sweep.en: to clean a floor by pushing dirt away with a brush

ex.en: A blast of cold air swept through the house.
ex.zh: 一陣冷風吹過整間房子。

ex.en: Tsunamis swept through rice fields and flooded the towns.
ex.zh: 海嘯席捲稻田，淹沒了城鎮。

sweep.en: to move quickly and strongly across or through a place

ex.en: I swear I will never do such a thing.
ex.zh: 我發誓絕對不會做這種事。

ex.en: The knight swore an oath of allegiance to the king.
ex.zh: 騎士宣誓效忠國王。

ex.en: I swear I didn't tell anyone your secret.
ex.zh: 我發誓我沒把你的秘密告訴任何人。

swear.en: to make a serious promise that you are telling the truth or will do something

ex.en: Tom can't go three sentences without swearing.
ex.zh: 湯姆講不到三句話就會罵髒話。

ex.en: Please don't swear in front of the kids.
ex.zh: 請不要在孩子面前罵髒話。

swear.en: to use rude or offensive words, usually because you are angry (offensive)

ex.en: I don't have a sword.
ex.zh: 我沒有劍。

ex.en: This sword has a strange history.
ex.zh: 這把劍有一段奇特的歷史。

sword.en: a weapon with a long sharp metal blade and a handle

ex.en: Social media is a double-edged sword.
ex.zh: 社群媒體是一把雙面刃。

ex.en: Fame can be a double-edged sword.
ex.zh: 名氣可能是一把雙面刃。

sword.en: something that has both good and bad effects

ex.en: Progress was swift.
ex.zh: 進展很快。

ex.en: The stream is not very swift.
ex.zh: 水流不太湍急。

ex.en: Thank you for your swift reply.
ex.zh: 謝謝您迅速的回覆。

ex.en: He lives alone in a little cottage in the swamp.
ex.zh: 他獨自住在沼澤裡的一間小屋。

ex.en: Many birds live in the swamp.
ex.zh: 許多鳥類住在這片沼澤裡。

swamp.en: an area of soft wet land with many plants growing in it

swamp.zh: 使應接不暇、使忙不過來；淹沒

ex.en: I don't mean to swamp you.
ex.zh: 我不是故意要讓你忙不過來。

ex.en: We've been swamped with orders this week.
ex.zh: 這週我們的訂單多到忙不過來。

swamp.en: to give someone so much to deal with that they cannot cope, or to cover with water

ex.en: I can't swallow these tablets without a drink of water.
ex.zh: 不喝水的話，我吞不下這些藥片。

ex.en: Food should be chewed before being swallowed.
ex.zh: 食物要先嚼過再吞下去。

ex.en: It hurts when I swallow because of my sore throat.
ex.zh: 我喉嚨痛，吞東西的時候會痛。

swallow.en: to make food or drink go down your throat into your stomach

ex.en: A swallow flies very swiftly.
ex.zh: 燕子飛得非常快。

ex.en: In the autumn, swallows will fly south.
ex.zh: 到了秋天，燕子會往南飛。

swallow.en: a small bird with a forked tail that flies very fast

ex.en: The willow branches swayed gently in the breeze.
ex.zh: 柳枝在微風中輕輕搖曳。

ex.en: The crowd swayed to the music at the concert.
ex.zh: 演唱會上觀眾隨著音樂搖擺。

sway.en: to move slowly from side to side

ex.en: Don't let other people's opinions sway your decision.
ex.zh: 別讓別人的意見左右你的決定。

ex.en: His speech swayed many voters at the last minute.
ex.zh: 他的演講在最後一刻打動了許多選民。

sway.en: to change what someone thinks or decides

ex.en: Mary was a switchboard operator when she was younger.
ex.zh: 瑪麗年輕時當過總機接線員。

ex.en: Call the switchboard and ask for the HR department.
ex.zh: 打給總機，請他們轉人資部。

switchboard.en: a place in an office where phone calls are received and connected to the right people

ex.en: Sweat ran down his face after the long run.
ex.zh: 長跑之後，汗水順著他的臉流下。

ex.en: She wiped the sweat from her forehead with a towel.
ex.zh: 她用毛巾擦掉額頭上的汗。

ex.en: I always sweat a lot when I play basketball.
ex.zh: 我打籃球時總是流很多汗。

ex.en: Don't sweat the small stuff; everything will be fine.
ex.zh: 別為小事煩惱，一切都會沒事的。

ex.en: Swimming is a good exercise for the whole body.
ex.zh: 游泳是很好的全身運動。

ex.en: We go swimming at the pool every Saturday morning.
ex.zh: 我們每週六早上都去游泳池游泳。

ex.en: Swindon is a town in the south of England.
ex.zh: 史雲頓是英格蘭南部的一個城鎮。

ex.en: He takes the train from Swindon to London every day.
ex.zh: 他每天從史雲頓搭火車到倫敦。

ex.en: Sweden is a country in northern Europe.
ex.zh: 瑞典是北歐的一個國家。

ex.en: Stockholm is the capital of Sweden.
ex.zh: 斯德哥爾摩是瑞典的首都。

ex.en: Switzerland is a country in the middle of Europe.
ex.zh: 瑞士是位於歐洲中部的國家。

ex.en: Switzerland is famous for its mountains and chocolate.
ex.zh: 瑞士以山景和巧克力聞名。

ex.en: I bought a Swedish chair that was easy to put together.
ex.zh: 我買了一張很容易組裝的瑞典風格椅子。

ex.en: Swedish winters are long and dark.
ex.zh: 瑞典的冬天又長又黑暗。

ex.en: She is learning Swedish before she moves to Stockholm.
ex.zh: 她在搬去斯德哥爾摩之前正在學瑞典語。

ex.en: Swedish is the main language spoken in Sweden.
ex.zh: 瑞典語是瑞典主要使用的語言。

ex.en: Swiss watches are famous around the world.
ex.zh: 瑞士手錶聞名全世界。

ex.en: We took a Swiss train through the mountains.
ex.zh: 我們搭乘瑞士火車穿越群山。

ex.en: The Swiss are known for their chocolate and cheese.
ex.zh: 瑞士人以巧克力和起司聞名。

ex.en: A Swiss sat next to me on the plane and told me about Zurich.
ex.zh: 一位瑞士人在飛機上坐在我旁邊，跟我聊起蘇黎世。

sweeping.zh: 掃；橫掃（sweep 的現在分詞）

ex.en: He is sweeping the floor in the kitchen.
ex.zh: 他正在掃廚房的地板。

ex.en: A cold wind was sweeping across the empty field.
ex.zh: 一陣冷風正橫掃過空曠的田野。

ex.en: The school announced sweeping changes to the timetable.
ex.zh: 學校宣布了課表的全面調整。

ex.en: The new law brought sweeping reforms to the city.
ex.zh: 這項新法為這座城市帶來大幅度的改革。

ex.en: Saying that all teenagers are lazy is a sweeping statement.
ex.zh: 說所有青少年都懶惰是一種以偏概全的說法。

ex.en: Try not to make sweeping claims without proof.
ex.zh: 沒有證據時，盡量不要做籠統的斷言。

ex.en: The leaves swirled in the wind outside the door.
ex.zh: 門外的葉子在風中打著旋。

ex.en: She swirled the wine gently in her glass.
ex.zh: 她輕輕地在杯子裡轉動葡萄酒。

ex.en: Snow swirled around us as we walked up the hill.
ex.zh: 我們走上山坡時，雪在我們周圍打轉。

ex.en: A swirl of smoke rose from the campfire.
ex.zh: 一縷旋轉的煙從營火中升起。

ex.en: The artist painted a swirl of blue and white on the canvas.
ex.zh: 藝術家在畫布上畫了一道藍白相間的漩渦。

ex.en: A white swan floated quietly on the lake.
ex.zh: 一隻白天鵝靜靜地浮在湖面上。

ex.en: The swan spread its wings and flew away.
ex.zh: 天鵝展開翅膀飛走了。

ex.en: They were high school sweethearts and married after college.
ex.zh: 他們是高中時代的戀人，大學畢業後結了婚。

ex.en: He wrote a long letter to his sweetheart overseas.
ex.zh: 他寫了一封長信給遠在海外的心上人。

ex.en: Thanks for the tea, sweetheart.
ex.zh: 謝謝你泡的茶，親愛的。

ex.en: Could you pass me the salt, sweetheart?
ex.zh: 親愛的，可以把鹽遞給我嗎？

ex.en: She is a strong swimmer and crossed the lake easily.
ex.zh: 她游泳很強，輕鬆游過了湖。

ex.en: The swimmers waited for the whistle.
ex.zh: 游泳選手們等待哨聲響起。

ex.en: I was hot and sweaty after running up the hill.
ex.zh: 跑上山後，我又熱又滿身是汗。

ex.en: He wiped his sweaty hands on his jeans.
ex.zh: 他把汗濕的手在牛仔褲上擦了擦。

ex.en: A swarm of bees settled on the tree.
ex.zh: 一大群蜜蜂停在樹上。

ex.en: A swarm of reporters waited outside the hotel.
ex.zh: 一大群記者在飯店外等候。

ex.en: Fans swarmed around the singer as she left the stage.
ex.zh: 歌手下台時，歌迷蜂擁而上圍住她。

ex.en: Mosquitoes swarm near the water in summer.
ex.zh: 夏天水邊會有成群的蚊子飛舞。

ex.en: I like the sweetness of fresh strawberries.
ex.zh: 我喜歡新鮮草莓的甜味。

ex.en: The sweetness of her smile made everyone feel welcome.
ex.zh: 她笑容的甜美讓每個人都感到受歡迎。

ex.en: His ankle was swollen after the fall.
ex.zh: 他摔倒後腳踝腫了起來。

ex.en: The swollen river flooded the nearby fields.
ex.zh: 暴漲的河水淹沒了附近的農田。

ex.en: The eagle swooped down and caught a fish.
ex.zh: 老鷹俯衝而下，抓走了一條魚。

ex.en: Bats swoop over the pond at dusk.
ex.zh: 黃昏時蝙蝠會掠過池塘上空。

ex.en: The owl's swoop was silent and fast.
ex.zh: 貓頭鷹的俯衝安靜又迅速。

ex.en: Police made a swoop on the market early this morning.
ex.zh: 警方今天一早突擊搜查了這個市場。

ex.en: There is some swelling around his left ankle.
ex.zh: 他左腳踝周圍有些腫脹。

ex.en: Put ice on it to reduce the swelling.
ex.zh: 用冰敷來消腫。

ex.en: The swelling crowd filled the whole square.
ex.zh: 不斷增多的人群擠滿了整個廣場。

ex.en: The swelling river flooded the low fields.
ex.zh: 不斷上漲的河水淹沒了低窪的田地。
